prerequisites: It is recommended to have passed the first three years of the Industrial Electronic and Automatic Engineering degree.

learning_outcomes.text: Integrate knowledge from the subjects of the chosen specialization to carry out a practical project.
Develop critical thinking for evaluating different alternatives in solving a complex problem.
Perform calculations according to current regulations and select the necessary industrial elements for a project within the scope of the specialization.
Defend the work carried out in the laboratory in a public presentation.

syllabus_topics: Definition of objectives and analysis of project requirements.
Hierarchical design and definition of functional blocks.
assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, the Laboratory Notebook requires at least 4 verification signatures to be evaluated. The Project Report must achieve a minimum of 5 out of 10 points to be counted. The final grade is calculated as (0.25 x C) + (0.5 x I) + (0.25 x D), provided the minimums for each block are met. For the extraordinary call, if the project was completed in the first semester with correct laboratory notebook tracking (four dated signatures), evaluation is the same as the ordinary call. For differentiated evaluation, if the student can follow the project (even remotely), evaluation is the same as the ordinary call; otherwise, a single theoretical-practical exam will be administered.
